author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

IPR007581

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

pombe https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC1F12.06c
human https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8N8Q3/entry

* **Description of issue**

Human entry has a caution:
Was initially characterized as an endodeoxyribonuclease involved in DNA repair (PubMed:[22664237](https://www.uniprot.org/citations/22664237)).
While it shows some weak endodeoxyribonuclease activity in vitro, such activity probably does not exist in vivo

and now lots of annotation for a role in RNA biology rather than DNA
e.g. 
Endoribonuclease that specifically cleaves inosine-containing RNAs: cleaves RNA at the second phosphodiester bond 3' to inosine (PubMed:[31703097](https://www.uniprot.org/citations/31703097)).
title: GO:0006281	 DNA repair IEA with IPR007581
